title: Bozeman Hot Springs

services.name: Deluxe Tent Sites
services.desc: which border a large creek. Each has a concrete parking pad, grassy yard for your tent, and electric/water hookups. A picnic table and fire ring also come with these

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Venues are available all days a week, but need to start at least an hour after we open and end at least an hour before we close You can bring in cake and dessert-type foods, but we don’t allow outside foods like pizza or sandwiches, as we now serve that in our cafe Definitely! Upon reservation, we’ll send you a food ordering form, so your cafe order can be ready up to 30 minutes after the party

services.name: 30-Amp Full Hookup (C-Row)
services.desc: 30-amp full hookup back-in under the pine trees. Natural forest yard. Each site has a picnic table & fire

explain.meaning: The site connects your RV to power, water and sewer.
A standard RV power connection, enough for one air conditioner.

services.name: One-Room Camping Cabin
services.desc: Two-room camping cabins which face a grassy, park-like area. Each cabin contains a queen-sized bed, two pairs of twin-sized bunk beds, two desks, and an AC unit. They can sleep 6-7 people and come with a covered porch with a swing. A large patio, picnic table, and fire ring accommodate each

blurb: For more than 100 years, visitors have come to relax and rejuvenate in these natural hot springs.
